_about: Listen mode rules for Hazing Module 5 (Report Hazing Through Appropriate Channels). Same contract as data/sharps-listen/config.json, read by js/layered-hazing.js. `sectors` names each AUDIENCE's package (athletes | greek, the Context lens). The packages are PLACEHOLDERS: machine-voiced opening lines of each chapter's narration. Replace an audience's folder with the produced package (same topic ids: open, k1, k2, f1, close; versions base/testup/universal/reinforced) and bump audioVersion. Triggers follow the structure map: 5.1 right on the pre-check skips the k1 chapter (test-out on) or plays its testup (test-out off, test-up on); 5.3 agreement (mean of the two statements) at or below 3 plays f1's reinforced version (M5-03R).

titles._about: Fallback chapter names; each package's manifest carries its own audience's titles.

handBack._about: The hand-back to the screen, borrowed from Sharps' placeholder package (resolved from this package's folder).

sents.t: You may now continue the lesson.

checks._about: The question asked after the listen for each topic, as the chapter screen whose question it is, per the version that played. The 5.1 test-up (harder) has no check, per the structure map; "none" asks nothing.

review._about: A missed 5.1 question gets the audience's M5-01R narration as fact cards, then ONE retry. 5.2 is ask policy and never remediates, so it has no review. {sector} in a cards path is the audience.
